full_run_gate: Run the full 539-left probe only if the 64-left result has independently replayed sampled roots, zero kernel errors, and projected full-loop kernel time below 240 seconds; otherwise record a bounded stop.
resource_envelope: one local process and one native kernel thread on the unisolated macOS host; record process peak RSS and exit status
claim_boundary: Kernel throughput and sampled S3-root correctness only. No full index, six-summand PDP, ordinary relation yield, DLP, rho pair, or CPU speedup.
